yummy--adj.def: Tasting very good, in informal speech.

grown-up--adj.ex: Her children are grown up now.

grown-up--noun.def: An adult, as children call them.
grown-up--noun.ex: Ask a grown up for help.

blend--noun.def: A mixture of different types, especially of tea or coffee.

chancellor--noun.def: The head of government in some countries, or of a university.

gardener--noun.def: A person who looks after a garden.

dwarf--noun.def: A very small imaginary person in old stories.

pint--noun.def: A unit of liquid, a little over half a litre.
pint--noun.ex: He ordered a pint of milk.

boost--noun.def: An increase or an improvement in something.
boost--noun.ex: The news gave sales a boost.

gaze--noun.def: A long steady look at something.

nuisance--noun.def: A person or thing that annoys you.
nuisance--noun.ex: The barking is a real nuisance.

donate--verb.def: To give money or goods to help others.

relieve--verb.def: To make pain or a problem less serious.

presidential--adj.def: Relating to a president or the office of president.
presidential--adj.ex: The presidential election is in May.

rental--noun.def: The act of renting, or the money paid for it.

dorm--noun.def: A building where students live at a school.
dorm--noun.ex: She shares a room in the dorm.

dismiss--verb.def: To send someone away from a job, or to refuse to consider an idea.
dismiss--verb.ex: He dismissed the idea at once.

overall--adj.def: Considering everything, not just one part.

daughter-in-law--noun.ex: His daughter in law is a teacher.

housekeeper--noun.def: A person employed to manage a house or a hotel floor.

long-term--adj.ex: This is a long term investment.

zoom--noun.def: A camera setting that makes distant things look nearer.
zoom--noun.ex: Use the zoom for that bird.

portion--noun.def: A part of something, or the amount of food for one person.

despise--verb.def: To dislike someone very strongly and have no respect for them.

await--verb.def: To wait for something, in formal English.

telescope--noun.def: A tube with lenses for looking at distant objects.

verse--noun.def: A group of lines in a poem or a song.

verse--verb.ex: The old tale was versed for children.

addicted--adj.def: Unable to stop using or doing something.
addicted--adj.ex: He is addicted to his phone.

wit--noun.def: The ability to say clever funny things.

estimate--noun.def: A judgement of an amount, or a stated price for work.

tutor--noun.def: A teacher who works with one student or a small group.

impulse--noun.def: A sudden strong wish to do something.

penguin--noun.def: A black and white bird that swims but cannot fly.
penguin--noun.ex: A penguin dived into the water.

peacefully--adv.def: In a calm way, without violence.

rag--noun.def: An old piece of cloth used for cleaning.

stern--adj.def: Serious and strict, and not kind.
stern--adj.ex: The teacher gave a stern look.

dearly--adv.def: Very much, or at a great cost.

humiliation--noun.def: The shame of being made to look foolish.

worldwide--adj.def: Happening in or affecting the whole world.

bidding--noun.def: The offering of prices at an auction.

masterpiece--noun.def: The best work an artist has produced.

pentagon--noun.def: A flat shape with five straight sides.

regime--noun.def: A government, especially one that is strict or unfair.

contempt--noun.def: The feeling that someone deserves no respect.

tackle--verb.def: To start dealing with a difficult problem.
tackle--verb.ex: The city tackled the traffic problem.

wage--noun.def: Money paid weekly for work, often manual.

scooter--noun.def: A light motorcycle, or a child's two-wheeled toy.
scooter--noun.ex: She rides a scooter to work.

supernatural--adj.def: Impossible to explain by the laws of nature.

bankrupt--verb.def: To make a person or a company unable to pay debts.

compensation--noun.def: Money paid to someone for loss or injury.
compensation--noun.ex: She received compensation for the damage.

stitch--noun.def: One loop of thread made when sewing.

rib--noun.def: One of the curved bones around the chest.

ban--noun.def: An official order that something must not be done.
ban--noun.ex: The ban on smoking starts today.

monastery--noun.def: A building where monks live and pray.
monastery--noun.ex: The monastery sits on a cliff.

recruit--verb.def: To find new people to join a company or an army.

ignorance--noun.def: A lack of knowledge about something.
ignorance--noun.ex: Ignorance of the law is no excuse.

artery--noun.def: A tube carrying blood away from the heart.

dynamic--adj.def: Full of energy and new ideas, or always changing.

unbearable--adj.def: Too painful or unpleasant to accept.

employer--noun.def: A person or company that pays people to work.

grim--adj.def: Worrying and unpleasant, or looking very serious.

medieval--adj.def: Belonging to the period from about 1100 to 1500.
medieval--adj.ex: The town has a medieval wall.
medieval--adj.exTr: Kasabanın ortaçağdan kalma bir duvarı var.

microwave--noun.def: An oven that heats food very quickly.
microwave--noun.ex: Warm the soup in the microwave.

funky--adj.def: Modern and unusual in a pleasing way.
funky--adj.ex: The café has a funky style.

deceive--verb.def: To make someone believe something untrue.

consultant--noun.def: An expert paid for advice, or a senior hospital doctor.

unacceptable--adj.def: So bad that it cannot be allowed.

plumber--noun.def: A worker who repairs water pipes.
plumber--noun.ex: Call a plumber about the leak.

ox--noun.def: A large male cow used for pulling heavy loads.

heritage--noun.def: The traditions and buildings passed down from the past.

nightclub--noun.def: A place open late for dancing and drinks.

preliminary--adj.def: Coming before the main part of something.

valid--adj.def: Legally acceptable, or based on good reasoning.
